name: "Outstanding Entrepreneur" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises”
benefit: Cash Award of ₹2,00,000/- and a Citation.
_eligibility_text:
- The unit shall be functioning profitably for 3 years before the date of application.
- The unit should provide atleast 60% of employment to the people of UT of Puducherry of the total employment strength of the industrial units.
